DialogueOption.Text: What did you want from me again?
I met with Chert, they showed me an new system with an incredibly massive black hole.
I made it to a new star system!

Dialogue.Page: Chert wanted to talk to you about something important. They said it had something to do with a massive star going supernova.
Whatever it was, they seemed very excited about their find! You wouldn't want to leave them hanging, would you?
Yeah, Chert had their eye on that star because they were eager to see it go supernova.
A black hole more massive than previously thought possible...I'm sure Chert's studying it like crazy!
Stars above, you have? How on Hearth did you manage to do it?
Best of luck on your travels!
